title: Signature Seed Partitioning
description: Signature-original: Gives each worker a disjoint seed range so generated records never collide by construction. Recorded facts — Mechanism: Seed Partitioning; Problem: ID collisions; Guarantee: disjoint outputs. Used by fleet-scale content generators, database fill programs, and distributed build systems. Built as a Signature-authored original for the JAH network; clearly labeled Signature and never presented as a public record.
demo:
# Signature Seed Partitioning — runnable demo (python3)
# Seed Partitioning - shard assignment (python3)
workers=8
tasks=10000
assign=[0]*workers
for t in range(tasks):
    assign[hash(("task", t)) % workers]+=1
print("tasks per worker:", assign)
print("max skew:", max(assign)-min(assign))
